messages.content_text: We need staging deploys to stop being manual ssh snowflake work. Can we standardize?

For what staging runs on today, the workable path is the VM: ssh deploy@staging-box-old, then run ./deploy_via_ansible.sh staging from the checkout. That wraps the ansible playbook and does health-gated rollout.
Fine. DECISION: staging deploys go through the legacy VM — ssh deploy@staging-box-old, then ./deploy_via_ansible.sh staging. This is the only supported path for staging.
Recorded. I'll use that path for every staging deploy until we say otherwise.
